description: Communes de St-Jean-de Luz et de Ciboure : Etude des processus d’envasement du port is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by casagec.fr. In October 2002, at the request of fishermen whose boats are increasingly stranded in the port and after a lengthy investigation under the Water Law, the Pyrénées Atlantiques General Council dredged the port of Saint-Jean-de-Luz/Ciboure: 10,000 m3 were removed from the centre of the basin and lapped at sea. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Communes of St-Jean-de Luz and Ciboure: Study of port silting processes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include envasement, OCA_littoral, bathymétrie, inspire, nivelle. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
